recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is recommended for FHIR-25261 unless a future work-group decision reintroduces operation endpoint support for historical resource versions.
issue_request: FHIR-25261 was a Published/Persuasive R4 technical correction for the Operations framework. It reported that the Executing an Operation section said operations could be invoked on four FHIR endpoint types while listing only the base service, resource type, and resource instance endpoints; the resolution said to change the count from four to three because operations on history were no longer supported.
initial_application: No commit message explicitly mentioning FHIR-25261 was found. Git history shows commit 142ad7624ca77d81a9463a6ddbd278f521a109da changed source/operations.html from "four types" to "three types" for the relevant sentence, so the source correction appears to have been applied implicitly before R5 publication.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes operations.html as the Operations page, so source/operations.html is in current build scope. The current source says three endpoint types at source/operations.html:67 and lists base, resource type, and resource instance endpoints at lines 70-72. FHIR-I minutes from 2020-04-13 list FHIR-25261 as a technical correction, and no conflicting Zulip or Confluence search hits were found.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current in-build source already implements the requested correction, and a source search found no remaining current-source occurrence of the erroneous "four types" wording.
